# AI Wise

> AI Wise is the one-person AI, data and automation practice of Simon van
> Meegdenburg, based in Amsterdam, the Netherlands. It builds practical internal
> tools, workflow automation, dashboards and reporting flows for small
> organizations, roughly up to twenty-five people, doing work that serves life,
> health, care, learning, regeneration or human development. Tagline: Automation
> in Service of Life.

The website is a single page in Dutch and English. It describes what AI Wise
stands for and how to make contact. It deliberately carries no service
catalogue, no pricing and no productised offer: the practice is young and is
currently working out where AI opportunities lie in real organizations.

## What AI Wise does

- Workflow automation for recurring manual work, such as data re-entered by hand
  between systems, reports rebuilt from the same exports every month, or notes
  written out a second time.
- Small internal tools that fit an existing way of working rather than a platform
  to migrate onto.
- Dashboards, reporting flows and data groundwork, so records an organization
  already holds become something it can query and report on.
- Build-first delivery with handover: documentation and enough explanation that
  the client can keep using and running the result without AI Wise.

The website gives these as illustrations of what is possible, not as a service
catalogue. They are examples to think with, and the site says so.

## What AI Wise does not do

- No pricing, packages or scope are published on the website.
- No case studies, client names or testimonials are published, because none are
  confirmed for public use.
- No claims are made about time saved, safety or privacy outcomes.

## Contact

The site invites two kinds of message, and treats both as equally welcome: an
organization orienting itself on what AI could mean for its work, and a fellow
developer building with AI who wants to compare notes. Contact runs by email at
simon@aiwise.it.com or by WhatsApp on +31 6 13926494. There is no contact form.

## Crawling

Regular search crawlers, AI search and discovery crawlers, and user-triggered
fetchers are welcome to read and cite this site. Model-training crawlers are
disallowed in robots.txt; that is a deliberate and separate choice from being
findable in AI-assisted search.
